page_title: TOR 0-0 FIO | Torino v Fiorentina 31/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
85' Torino have a corner.
83' Today's match ends for Albert Gudmundsson who will be replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina).
81' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cyril Ngonge.
81' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Kristjan Asllani is replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
79' Fouls committed – 18:12.
78' The corner kick from Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
77' Roberto Piccoli will be replaced by Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina).
76' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) replaces Cristiano Biraghi.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) will replace Ivan Ilic.
74' That's unlucky! Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
73' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) has tested the patience of referee Rosario Abisso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
72' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar.
72' Fiorentina will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
70' Saul Coco (Torino) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
69' Torino get a corner.
68' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

68' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
67' Corner kicks – 2:3.
66' That's the end of the game for Rolando Mandragora, who is replaced by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina).
66' Torino are ruled offside.
64' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

64' Torino slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
62' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Giovanni Simeone and he is replaced by Che Adams (Torino).

60' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
60' The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
58' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
57' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
55' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
55' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Kristjan Asllani (Torino) commits a foul after dangerous play.
53' Dodo (Fiorentina) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Fiorentina players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
49' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' Stefano Pioli makes a switch. Nicolo Fagioli is coming on in place of Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Stefano Pioli probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina). He is replaced by Eddy Kouadio.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

44' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) wastes an opportunity! He unleashed a strong shot from distance after the rebound fell at his feet. It went low in the direction of the middle of the target and the goalkeeper pulled off a save to deny him.
44' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Fiorentina.
43' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) commits a rough challenge and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.

41' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at David de Gea. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
38' A short pass finds Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
38' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
37' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
35' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

34' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Franco Israel is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
33' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
32' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

29' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
29' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Torino out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
27' A player from Fiorentina commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
27' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner.
27' An attempted cross from Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is cleared. Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
26' Flag goes up against Nikola Vlasic (Torino) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' The possession of the ball – 36:64.
23' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
19' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.

17' Dodo (Fiorentina) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
15' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
14' Torino will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
14' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Simon Sohm (Fiorentina). Rosario Abisso saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
12' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Cesare Casadei (Torino) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by David de Gea.
7' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
6' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
4' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Rosario Abisso blows the whistle, Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Torino will take a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Rosario Abisso.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text coverage. We will try to provide you with a detailed image of what's happening on the pitch. There are only few moments left to the beginning of the match.
